verdict.rationale: Databricks Marketplace lists third-party datasets alongside models, notebooks, apps and MCP servers as a single catalog across the partner ecosystem. Providers publish offerings that customers can discover, evaluate and connect to directly from their workspace, and Delta/OpenSharing is the underlying sharing mechanism. This covers the core of an in-platform third-party data marketplace. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that acquired listings appear as queryable tables you can join with your own data (enrichment is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace workflow.
